name: Octopus
tagline: the pulse jet: inhale, release, keep the beat
summary: The pulse jet. Hold LT to inhale: it slows, the mantle swells, the charge fills in 0.7 s. Release and it jets, up to 205 u/s, then fades toward a 20 u/s drift. The beat is yours: release at the same interval as your last two pulses and the chain grows, each pulse ×1.1 more, up to ×1.8. RT spends a pulse of charge on an ink cloud of danger prisms behind you. Charge-and-release movement with a rhythm layer you set yourself.

spec.v: LT inhale, release to jet · your own tempo multiplies · RT ink
charge-release (Kirby Air Riders, Mario Kart World) + rhythm (Hi-Fi Rush)

fantasy: It breathes its way round the course. Find your tempo and the whole race turns into a song you are drumming on the trigger.
why: One held input with a visible gauge and a release 'moment' is what players praise in Kirby Air Riders and Mario Kart World's charge jump, and rhythm-synced movement has a devoted audience (Hi-Fi Rush 2M+, a sequel at Krafton). The Octopus makes the rhythm optional: a tempo you set, not one imposed, so it rewards without gating.

charge.name: Jet
charge.tip: Charge is the speed of a full jet.

mass.name: Ink
mass.tip: Mass is the size of the ink cloud.

styles.name: Balanced
styles.info: Every element at 0: the recipe's numbers.

styles.name: Drummer
styles.info: Quick breaths and a wide beat: long chains.

styles.name: Squid
styles.info: Big jets and big ink: the ambusher.

styles.name: Maxed
styles.info: Every element at 10. A ceiling, not a match state.

notModelled: The beat is a timing window on the trigger with a HUD ring, no sound: the game would give it an FMOD tempo cue (the research says a timed window needs an unmistakable audio tell).
Ink is ordinary danger mass: it hurts the Octopus too after its 1 s grace, as every danger prism hurts every domain.
sources: Design: Docs/Studios/CONCEPT_FLEET.md (Octopus). Nearest shipped relatives: the Dolphin's drift charge and discharge, the Serpent's fuel pellets.
